name: COVID-19 Vaccinations by Age and Race-Ethnicity - Historical

columns.name: Week End
columns.description: The ending date of the seven-day period covered by the record.

columns.name: Race/Ethnicity
columns.description: Values used are: Latinx; Black, non-Latinx; White, non-Latinx; Asian, non-Latinx; Other, non-Latinx; Unknown; All

columns.name: Population Size
columns.description: Number of people in the combination of the age and race/ethnicity group

columns.name: 1st Dose
columns.description: Number of people who have received one dose.

columns.name: 1st Dose Percent
columns.description: Percentage of people who have received one dose.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed
columns.description: Number of people who have a completed vaccine series.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed Percent
columns.description: Percentage of people who have a completed vaccine series.

columns.name: Boosted
columns.description: Number of people who have a completed vaccine series and have received at least one additional dose through the date. This includes people who received a booster dose and immunocompromised people who received an additional primary dose of COVID-19 vaccine.

columns.name: Boosted Percent
columns.description: Percentage of people who have a completed vaccine series and have received at least one additional dose through the date. This includes people who received a booster dose and immunocompromised people who received an additional primary dose of COVID-19 vaccine.

columns.name: Bivalent
columns.description: Number of people who have received a bivalent (updated) vaccine dose.

columns.name: Bivalent Percent
columns.description: Percentage of people who have received a bivalent (updated) vaccine dose.
